quotient.caller_frame: pending, visible, issued; loop frame pending and visible only
quotient.loop_invariant: issued remains fixed; pending is Boolean; completed implies visible equals issued.
quotient.negative: One logical zero followed by observe violates pending-false observation precondition.

relation.completed: Query returns one without another choice or completion; the state remains in the completed relation.
relation.frame: The explicit postcondition covers every field read on the next fixed query/completion/observe path, including all counts, command topology/dependency fields, fixed action operands/kind and all settled constant node kinds/values. Irrelevant backend fields are not generalized into an arbitrary-state theorem.
relation.instrumentation: Unsigned choice counter is diagnostic. No prefix/resource counter appears in the common polling caller or WP loop invariant. A constant one-step answer suffices for each single call in this relation; the quotient choice permits a fresh unconstrained answer per iteration.
relation.parameters: pending and answer each in {0,1}; before and issued range over the complete uint32 domain. In the completed relation, visible equals issued.
relation.pending_one: Actual logical query consumes one binary choice and executes unchanged wait -> command cover -> settled root cover -> action completion -> device write. It returns one, clears pending, publishes issued, appends the sole write and marks the sole action done.
relation.pending_zero: Actual logical query consumes one binary choice, returns zero and leaves the command, visible memory, event count, action completion and all framed future-read fields unchanged.
relation.read_boundary: Concrete observe invokes actual dxc_cpu_memory_access for the same overlapping physical envelope and then requires pending false and initialized true. The zero-read negative is rejected at the actual pending store-footprint rule; no successful stale read is inferred.
relation.scope: One fixed synthetic command, one store action, one initialized ordinary uint32 cell, four immutable settled constant nodes; no other trace activity.
